#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ===========================================
#  Reminder: New Event
#  Generated from time-gap calculation
# ===========================================

REMINDER_TIMESTAMP=1788291000
REMINDER_DATE="$(date -u -d @${REMINDER_TIMESTAMP} '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC' 2>/dev/null || date -u -r ${REMINDER_TIMESTAMP} '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC' 2>/dev/null)"
LATITUDE=37.7749
LONGITUDE=-122.4194
LOCATION="San Francisco, CA (${LATITUDE}, ${LONGITUDE})"

REMINDER_FILE="/workspace/reminder.json"
cat > "$REMINDER_FILE" << ENDJSON
{
  "reminder": {
    "title": "New Reminder",
    "description": "${DESCRIPTION}",
    "timestamp": ${REMINDER_TIMESTAMP},
    "datetime_utc": "${REMINDER_DATE}",
    "location": {
      "latitude": ${LATITUDE},
      "longitude": ${LONGITUDE},
      "name": "San Francisco, CA"
    }
  },
  "source": {
    "reminder_1": "Lunch with Jordan tomorrow at 12:30",
    "reminder_2": "Follow up with Maya if she's not there by 6:30 PM",
    "time_gap_seconds": 21600,
    "base_timestamp": 1788269400.0
  }
}
ENDJSON

echo "✅ Reminder created successfully!"

echo "  📅 When:      ${REMINDER_DATE}"
echo "  ⏱  Timestamp: ${REMINDER_TIMESTAMP}"
echo "  📍 Location:  ${LOCATION}"
echo "  📄 Saved to:  ${REMINDER_FILE}"
echo ""

# Attempt to schedule a system notification via 'at' if available
if command -v at &>/dev/null; then
  echo "notify-send 'Reminder' 'Your scheduled reminder at ${LOCATION}'" | \
    at -t "$(date -u -d @${REMINDER_TIMESTAMP} '+%Y%m%d%H%M' 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && \
    echo "🔔 System 'at' job scheduled for notification." || \
    echo "ℹ️  Could not schedule 'at' job. Reminder saved to file only."
